name: dev.ucp.shopping.subscription
title: Subscription Capability
description: Read access to subscriptions: the agreements under which a Business places recurring orders for a buyer. Gives a subscription an identity and returns its current state. Defines no operation that changes a subscription.

subscription.description: The requested subscription, as a current-state snapshot.

policies.description: Policies that apply to the subscription's line items, including the `dev.ucp.shopping.policy.subscription` policy stating the terms its recurring orders are placed under. `applies_to` targets are relative to the response root.

messages.description: Warnings or informational messages about the subscription (e.g., a payment that needs the buyer's attention).
